description: CyberMirror explains prospective admission and continuity-guard concepts, the public integration contract, connector catalogue and result interpretation. Its public tools retrieve guidance only. They do not authenticate customers, register connectors, make live admission decisions or actuate controls. Allow, warn and block are outcomes within supplied state and declared guard policy, not safety guarantees or evidence of intent. Readiness metadata and audit traces do not establish independent certification. The module remains experimental.
